image_description: A full-body shot of a large, dark greyish-green iguana resting on a paved or gravel surface. The iguana is facing right, with its head raised. It features a prominent dorsal crest running down its spine, a visible dewlap under the chin, and a long, banded tail extending to the left. The background consists of blurred green foliage.
